title: Where Exactly Did My Life Start to Change Shape

body.text: Original Report

Reporter: let me sort out the timeline. On March 15 I went home; by then I hadn't taken dextro for five or six months. I was alone at home, my friends were all at school, so in the end I went to a QQ group and found a boss called 'Sakurazaki Ayaka'.

Reporter: the time before that I o'd a lot (actually it was that my tolerance was too high), and I'd had a bit of alcohol before o-ing. Around 22:00 I took it, and by 23:31 it was obvious — my body itching and so on — and by the second half of the night I lost consciousness.

Reporter: after that it was like the sigma plateau. First it looped some things I can't describe in drug terms (like the reality Diavolo can never reach) — the things I've feared all my life surfaced as if real. Then I felt I was in space, in the universe, I felt I was a god, as if I'd seen through this world.

Reporter: the next morning I didn't want to eat anything; sounds, smells, everything felt amplified many times over. A friend came over to play games; I played Honor of Kings and thought I'd played all afternoon, and only when I came to did I learn it was two matches. I felt a whole day had passed.

Reporter: only on the third day did I get a bit back to normal. But because of that I didn't dare take dextro again; still, because of the craving, I dug through tg and Twitter looking for something else to play with, bought two sheets of ███ from ███, tried memantine and amantadine too, and finally found out about the od wiki and tried pregabalin. But none of them had that happy feeling.

Reporter: the last part is late April, early May. I went to Guangdong with a friend to work, stayed in a hotel four or five days, and used every day. Back in Henan, after the travel money I looked up Totsuka Ayaka (probably another account of 'Sakurazaki Ayaka'). On May 1 she still replied to my messages.

Reporter: on May 7 I woke up and found dextro had been promoted, so I felt I couldn't go on like this. I talked with a few pill heads too, asked what to do. They said stock up; one went to a dealer, one went to buy guaifenesin tablets. In a daze I came to my senses and chose to stop.

Reporter: after that I stayed at my mother's place, and she found me a factory job. I'd met those oders before, and I kept trying to talk them out of o-ing. The women were enslaved by the drugs and willing to sell themselves; the men broke the law for the drugs.
Reporter: it's a good ending, isn't it? I saw the od wiki and the May 13 dextro withdrawal from sale. And the oders' already-eroded brains. Normal people think they're wrong; they don't think so.

Reporter: after 'Sakurazaki Ayaka' killed herself, I looked for another dealer. That 2.0 one — it was when he posted that he'd stopped selling that I realised it couldn't wait, so I looked for ███ again.

Reporter: I don't know if after two years I still have a Qing dynasty mindset. I thought a boy and a girl holding hands was already very intimate; then a girl kissed me and afterwards said, aren't we friends?

Reporter: maybe it's just that my mental capacity is too poor now; I still can't accept a world like this. Right now I can't fit into any of those circles. od drugs, but no self-harm, and I don't do cpdd in games and the like. Or rather, I could fit in anywhere, but I'm just not that kind of person.
Reporter: what the hell is this, your contact Ayaka is already dead.
Reporter: I know.
Reporter: I'm really scared I'll end up on the same road as Sakurazaki Ayaka.
Reporter: pretty lost. Don't know what to do.
Contact: [A screenshot showing the reporter posting a suicide notice on WeChat Moments.]
Reporter: the deceased: me.
Reporter: after taking ███, ███ and ███ in batches, suicide (unknown whether by drowning or drug poisoning). Male. Remember to contact @SuperGotoGotoGotō on Twitter.
